name: NIC Physics-of-Failure run-to-failure dataset
paper: Physics-of-Failure-Guided Run-to-Failure Predictive Maintenance Dataset Generation and Analysis for Network Interface Cards

cold.median_lifetime_note: exceeds the 43,800-h horizon (33 of 67 cards failed)

definitions.rows: card-hours (one row per card per hour; failed cards end at their failure hour)
definitions.median_lifetime_h: median of lifetime_h over all cards of the environment, censored cards counted as +inf (Table III)
definitions.failed_lifetime_min_h / failed_lifetime_: range of lifetime_h over failed cards (Table III 'Failed-life range')
definitions.mean_T_junction_C / p95_T_junction_C / m: statistics over all rows of the environment (Table III)
definitions.weibull_shape / weibull_scale_h: censoring-aware Weibull maximum-likelihood fit to (lifetime_h, failed) per environment, as reported in the paper (Table III, Fig. 2): SciPy Nelder-Mead on (log k, log lambda) with lifetimes in years, start (2, 5 y), default tolerances. A fully converged fit agrees to within 0.01% (hot 2.3993 / 12954.6 h, cold 2.4636 / 50895.7 h, controlled 3.5263 / 47903.9 h)
